result.card: Bitcoin Core ignores BIP35 mempool messages from peers that have transaction relay disabled, unless explicitly granted the mempool permission. Currently, an inbound peer can connect with fRelay=false to bypass the node's inbound transaction-relay capacity limits while still requesting full mempool inventory. This closes a loophole introduced with the inbound transaction-relay capacity enforcement in PR #28463 while preserving SPV clients that issue BIP37 filterload before requesting mempool contents.
